mission: Make the coach review record production-complete and immutable-with-amendments, so that when real qualified coaches exist, only their human evidence remains external.
method: Extended the authoritative CoachReview schema (packages/swing-lab/src/coachReview.ts) from v2 to v3: added phase-specific evaluation (stroke-phases-v1: preparation/backswing/contact/follow_through/recovery), explicit primaryFaultId (null when no faults), evidence frames alongside timestamps, structured DrillSuggestion (whyApplies, recommended/alternative role, progression/regression notes, equipment requirements, skill-level relevance), and a ReviewProvenance block (coach qualification snapshot, video/annotation ref + revision, analysis/model versions, raw labels shown to the coach, adjudication state). Pre-existing v2 fields already covered stroke identity confirmation, overall quality (anchored 1-5, nullable only when unassessable), secondary faults, severity, rationale, confidence, cannot-evaluate, taxonomy/drill-library versions, and timestamps.

validateCoachReview (and the admin-web mirror validate.ts) now enforces every new field: known/unique phase ids, notes required for flagged phases, primary fault consistency, non-negative integer frames, whyApplies on every drill suggestion, alternative drills require a recommended drill, and a provenance snapshot that must match the review's coach identity.

Dev API middleware (apps/admin-web/src/coachReview/labApi.ts) additionally cross-checks the provenance qualification snapshot against the HUMAN-managed coaches.json registry entry on both review and amendment writes, so qualification metadata cannot be fabricated client-side. Review/amendment/adjudication storage stays append-only (409 on any existing file; amendments are separate full-replacement files at sequential revisions >= 2).

Portal UI (ReviewForm.tsx) exposes the full v3 record: per-phase radio evaluation with honest 'not observable' default, evidence frame entry, structured drill suggestions with why-applies/progression/regression/equipment/skill-level, and automatic provenance capture from the registry entry and queue item at submission.

Added migration 0018_coach_review_records.sql via the repo migration runner: coach_review, coach_review_amendment, coach_review_adjudication tables, all append-only via BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE row triggers and BEFORE TRUNCATE statement triggers, sequential amendment revisions (>= 2, UNIQUE(review_id, revision), id-shape checks), synthetic coach ids rejected by CHECK constraint. Tables start and stay empty until real coaches exist.
Regenerated derived artifacts (queue.json v3, schema.json v3, taxonomy, drill library) via pnpm lab:coach-queue; held-out raw data untouched.

Tests: admin-web endpoint test proves an amendment is persisted as a NEW file while the base review bytes are unchanged and a duplicate amendment is refused; database integration test proves UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE on all three tables raise 'append-only', duplicate inserts are rejected, and an amendment insert leaves the base row's record untouched; fabricated qualification snapshots are refused with 422.
deliverables: packages/database/test/migrate.test.ts (append-only integration test, verified against Postgres 16)

verification.rootGates: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check — all green (593 passed, 4 skipped)
verification.databaseIntegration: migrations + append-only tests run green against local Postgres 16 with DATABASE_URL_TEST (same as CI)
verification.mobile: apps/mobile untouched; mobile gates not run
verification.swiftMacIphone: unavailable on this Linux box; no results claimed

whatRemainsIrreduciblyExternal: Real qualified coaches: coaches.json registry is still EMPTY; zero real reviews exist; recruitment and credential verification are human steps (docs/COACHING.md).
GATE A evidence: real coach reviews, inter-coach agreement, and adjudication of technique score / fault diagnosis / drill recommendation — all remain BLOCKED_ON_VALIDATION.
GATE B evidence: physical-iPhone real-user end-to-end validation.
Drill library remains UNVALIDATED placeholders with empty validatedFaultMappings until coach evidence arrives.
verdict: READY_PENDING_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE: the coach review record is production-complete (all required fields + provenance) and immutability-with-amendments is enforced and tested at file, API, and database layers. No coach data was fabricated; the validation lock is strengthened, not weakened.
